subject: Manipur 1971
summary: V18 flagged Manipur 1971 as depicting later boundaries. Rejected: the 1971 layer shows exactly the five districts created in 1969, and the 1981 layer the same four polygons (areas identical) under names adopted by RENAME in 1981. The flag came from the map-date rule counting renames as creations, fixed in 3.1.0.

subject: Mizoram (SOI 2025)
summary: The SOI 2025 layer still shows Mizoram's pre-2018 eight districts; Khawzawl and Saitual (2019) are absent. This causes the only three MERGED_INTO edges, into Champhai.
citation: Wikidata Q86882591 (Khawzawl), Q86882593 (Saitual), Q86882590 (Hnahthial); events compilation 2019 rows

subject: Fatehgarh Sahib; Barnala
summary: Both 1951 PEPSU districts closed with no lineage successor (Fatehgarh Sahib absorbed into Patiala; Barnala divided among Sangrur 64%, Bhatinda 20%, Ludhiana 16%) and return as new identities built mostly from their land (0.63 and 0.96). Linked by RECONSTITUTED_FROM (OD-01, option B).
